answer_1.quote: Human evaluation plays an essential role ... assessing summarization systems ...

answer_2.quote: We analyze several automatic metrics ... correlation with the ACU scores ...

answer_3.quote: We use the following prompt for calculating the recall score of the system outputs: ... The LLM‑predicted probability ... is used as the recall score. We also use G‑Eval with a 5‑point scale.

answer_4.quote: We recruit annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk ... three annotations per summary ... annotators indicate the presence of each ACU in the system summary.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are presented with atomic content units (ACUs) and asked to mark whether each ACU is present in the candidate summary; in other protocols they rate summaries on a 1‑5 scale.
